import csv
target = "f0a0044c-9c90-58fc-b425-307d0c874a2a"
vals = []
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    for r in csv.DictReader(f):
        if r["timeseries_id"] == target:
            vals.append((r["timestamp"], float(r["value"])))
vals.sort()
print(len(vals))
print(vals[:3])
print(vals[-3:])
high = max(v for _,v in vals)
th = 0.9 * high
print("high", high, "thr", th)
day0106 = [(t,v) for t,v in vals if t.startswith("2018-01-06")]
print(len(day0106))
print("all below", all(v < th for _,v in day0106))
print("max on day", max(v for _,v in day0106))
# check if any exceeds
print([(t,v) for t,v in day0106 if v >= th])
